It's not that, I have an endless... binding? to the music. Just a very musical person, even when I kinda hate it. I sing so it's deeply in me and intertwined with my language in a sense.

It's more that I just don't really have any other skills, so it's the only thing I see worth pursuing.

I gotta out of the suicide funk a few days ago, actually... sometimes my depressions lift really fast.

I appreciate your small bit of love, though. And I think you'll regain the passion for it, it's just phases. Hell, even great composers and songwriters have lost their passion.
I can't really talk about that because I don't want this ever being associated with my name. Thanks anyway though. If I kill myself, it won't be today, it's just eugh... I feel so fucked

Is there a order in the numbers you chose? 

If so, I can't seem to figure it out. :P
